uncertainties.note: Source '連邦政府' (Federation government) is untagged, unlike the tagged book(9) Earth Federation and book(38) New Federation entity IDs seen elsewhere in the corpus. King Sakomizu's rant is in the Wings of Rean/Byston Well storyline, not the parallel Gundam UC (Amuro/Bright/Jamil) thread, so it may mean the ACE3-original New Federation rather than Earth Federation; left as plain 'Federation' rather than guessing which.

'地上人' (people of 地上界/Upper Earth) has no locked rendering in any glossary file; translated compositionally as 'Upper Earth's people' from the locked 'Upper Earth' (encyclopedia_021_a.json). Not asserted as a locked term - see glossary proposal.

Context before and after (King Sakomizu's death, Luxe's grief) does not settle what prompts 'The Nanajin doesn't carry the Wings of Rean.' or who is speaking to whom; translated literally without adding an implied reason.
Wordless exclamation; likely Harry given his established emotional personality and that the very next line addresses him directly, but this is an inference, not stated outright by the source.

'三者連合' (lit. 'three-party alliance/union') names a coalition of which Neo Zeon is only one member; the other two parties are not identified in this slice or its context window. No existing glossary term found. Rendered as 'Tripartite Alliance' and proposed for centralization - see batch_06476_glossary_proposals.json.
